implementationGaps: HTML Brochure sets --venue-secondary/--venue-accent but never consumes them; Neutral not even wired — contradicts Accent/Neutral role hints and Settings description.
HTML Contract signing artifact sets all 4 vars but only consumes Primary.
Proposals claim brandability in Settings copy but ProposalArtifact uses zero venue colors.
Invoice snapshots Secondary but never paints it.
Brochure/Contract PDF resolve Accent+Neutral then ignore them.
Settings Brand colors description overstates uniform use across emails/proposals/contracts/brochures.
answers.smallestCoherentImplementationIfAny: Choose product intent first: (1) Wire HTML brochure (and optionally HTML contract artifact) to actually consume Secondary/Accent/Neutral in specific elements matching role hints, OR (2) Narrow Settings/BrandStep copy to match Primary-dominant reality and treat Secondary/Accent/Neutral as PDF/invoice/vendor-only. Do not invent new email uses. Do not merge Wedding Website Color Story into venue brand.
answers.intentionallyPrimaryOnly: Transactional email (explicit in venue-brand.ts). Public inquiry/tour CTAs are Primary-forward.
answers.classification: BOTH — implementation gap (HTML brochure/contract vars unused; proposals unwired) AND product-design gap (UI promises four-color branded materials; most couple-facing HTML surfaces are Primary-only or HTC defaults).
